text: 📚 IELTS Vocabulary ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Bugun o'rganadigan so'zimiz: Ubiquitous /juːˈbɪkwɪtəs/ Adjective 🇺🇿 Ma'nosi: Hamma joyda mavjud bo'lgan, keng tarqalgan. 💬 Misol: "Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern society." 💡 Kichik maslahat: Essay yozayotganda "common" yoki "everywhere" degan so'zlar juda ko'p takrorlanadi. Ularning o'rniga "ubiquitous" ishlatsangiz, Lexical Resource ballingiz ancha ko'tariladi!

📚 IELTS Vocabulary ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Bugun o'rganadigan so'zimiz: Mitigate /ˈmɪtɪɡeɪt/ Verb 🇺🇿 Ma'nosi: Yumshatmoq, yengillashtirmoq, kamaytirmoq (muammo yoki qiyinchilikni). 💬 Misol: "The government must take action to mitigate the effects of climate change." 💡 Kichik maslahat: Task 2 'Problem and Solution' essaylarida yechim yozayotganda "solve" o'rniga "mitigate the problem" (muammoni yumshatish) deb yozish ancha akademik va tabiiyroq eshitiladi.
